q: Choose the correct sentence:
o: Very few country in the world is so small as Vatican City.
No other country in the world are so small as Vatican City.
No other country in the world is so small as Vatican City.
No other country in the world is not so small as Vatican City.
e: "No other + singular noun + singular verb + so/as + adjective + as" গঠন positive degree-এ superlative ভাব দেয়। No other নিজেই না-বোধক, তাই আবার not বসানোর দরকার নেই। Country একবচন হওয়ায় verb is হবে। সঠিক বাক্য: No other country in the world is so small as Vatican City. Are বহুবচন verb, is not-যুক্ত বাক্যে double negative হয়, আর very few-র পরে বহুবচন noun ও বহুবচন verb লাগে।
